title: Positive Black Hole Indices in \( \mathcal{N}=4 \) and \( \mathcal{N}=8 \) String Theory
content: Sen predicted that the indices of single-centred black holes in string theory are positive. We prove this for type~II strings on T6 and T5 when \( \gcd(\ell_1,\ell_2)=1 \) in four dimensions and \( \gcd(Q_1,Q_5)=1 \) in five, at summed and at fixed angular momentum, and for heterotic dyons on T6 whose electric charge is r times a primitive vector, for every torsion r and every magnetic charge.
